changeSet.comment: NOT NULL with a default, so rows written by a previous build during a rolling deploy take false.

changeSet.author: abhijith
changeSet.comment: A project already marked completed whose tasks are not all complete (or which has no tasks) was completed by hand under the old rule. It stays completed and is flagged as a hand completion, so nothing changes on screen and a task change does not reopen it; a system admin can reopen it. A completed project whose every task is complete is left unflagged, which is what the task rule would have produced. A task counts as complete when its status is completed or its progress is 100, the same test the application uses.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE project SET completed_manually = true WHERE status = 'completed' AND completed_manually = false AND ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.project_id = project.id) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM task t WHERE t.project_id = project.id AND t.status <> 'completed' AND (t.progress IS NULL OR t.progress < 100) ) );
